{"consolidated_memory":"INTERMITTENT EOF IN crypto/tls/handshake.go — TWO SEPARATE INCIDENTS

Common elements:
- Both occurred in the security side of crypto/tls/handshake.go
- Both manifested as intermittent EOF (unexpected end of stream during negotiation)
- Both triggered by opening many short-lived connections in a row
- Both in the same corner of the codebase with shared context

OCCASION 1: [2026-04-03] Environment file misselection
Root cause: Config loader reading the wrong environment file
Trigger condition: Manifested only after the client had already retried once
Signal: Unexpected end of stream during negotiation
Duration impact: Alert stayed quiet for 74 consecutive days
Fix: Made environment selection explicit and failed closed on ambiguity
PR #5825 on branch fix/intermittent-eof-3

OCCASION 2: [2026-06-27] Listener not removed on teardown
Root cause: A listener registered but never removed
Trigger condition: Manifested when two requests raced on the same key
Signal: Unexpected end of stream during negotiation
Measured outcome: p99 latency fell from 9.9 s to 867 ms
Fix: Removed the listener on teardown and asserted it in a test
PR #7062 on branch fix/intermittent-eof-5"}
